Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

Meet the Team

Core to the health and growth of our business; the firm's active, multi-manager business model demands flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including the development of the next generation of analytical and trading capabilities.

Own agentic process automation: reverse-engineer manual, undocumented workflows and build agents that execute them reliably, including tool integrations, orchestration, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, state management, and auditability.
Build prediction and decision-support models: forecasting, anomaly detection, ranking, matching, and classification over years of accumulated firm data, with proper validation and monitoring.
Develop document intelligence pipelines for extraction, classification, and review across contracts, filings, emails, and transcripts.
Build entity intelligence and self-improving systems, including knowledge graphs, entity resolution, enrichment pipelines, and eval/feedback loops that improve deployed systems over time.
Embed directly with business teams to scope problems end-to-end, owning everything from the initial conversation through architecture, deployment, evaluation, and iteration.
Turn proven solutions into reusable capabilities for the broader firm.

3+ years shipping production software, ML, or AI systems (flexible for exceptional builders; what you’ve shipped matters more than years served).
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline.
Strong Python and engineering fundamentals; your prototypes become products others build on.

Supervised ML depth: training, validation, feature engineering, and awareness of pitfalls like leakage, overfitting, and drift.
Comfort with messy, heterogeneous data and unfamiliar domains, with the ability to become functionally fluent within days and earn credibility with subject-matter experts.
The autonomy to embed with a trader’s team or a CFO’s team, understand their world, and build without waiting for a spec.

added.title: Sr Applied Scientist, Embedded Battery Algorithms, Energy Storage
added.description:
Description

Do you want to write the algorithms that control next-generation batteries, and shape the future of energy storage? This role sits where electrochemistry, data/ML, and control theory meet. You will develop the physics-informed and data-driven methods that estimate state of charge, health, power capability, and remaining life, and validate them against lab and fleet data until they are ready to ship. Your algorithms will decide how hard a battery can be pushed, when it needs attention, and how long it will last, so they shape the safety, warranty, and economics of the whole product. You will work side by side with cell, systems, and software engineers, and as an early hire you will help define how we develop and validate battery algorithms.

This role can be based in Boston, Irvine, Sunnyvale, or Seattle, and involves occasional domestic and international travel, up to 10% of the time.

Key job responsibilities

Develop and own algorithms for state of charge, state of health, power capability, and remaining useful life, combining physics-based models with data-driven and estimation methods.
Deliver validated reference implementations, test vectors, and accuracy targets that define what production code must achieve.
Design the test plans and data needed to develop and validate algorithms, working with the cell and testing teams to turn lab and field data into model improvements.
Analyze algorithm performance across the deployed fleet, find where models drift or fail, and drive improvements.
Own the accuracy and robustness of battery algorithms, and sign off that production implementations match the validated reference. Provide algorithm evidence for safety certification.

A day in the life

Your week moves between data, models, and experiments. One day you might be working out why a health estimate drifts on cells that have aged in the field, and the next deciding which model structure holds accuracy at cold temperatures. You could be designing a test with the cell team to expose a behavior your model misses, or reviewing an implementation with an applied scientist to confirm that what ships matches what you validated. You will regularly share results with software, systems, and cell leaders, and your findings will shape decisions well beyond the algorithm itself.

About The Team

We are building Amazon's energy storage capability, providing power for advanced technologies while contributing to a stable grid. Our product is highly connected, yet secure and resilient by design. We own it end to end, from software, ML, and controls through system design to cell selection and supply, and on to a safety-certified product in the field. The organization operates like a startup inside Amazon: small, fast-moving, and accountable for our decisions. We work across hardware, software, and science, with suppliers and partners worldwide, and with Amazon infrastructure, procurement, legal, and finance.

The organization is at an early stage and growing quickly. You will be among the first algorithm hires, so you will help shape how we design, build, certify, and ship, with a direct line of sight to the product and business decisions your work informs. This is a dynamic role that will regularly present new challenges as the product and organization evolve.

Basic Qualifications

Master's degree in electrical engineering, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, applied mathematics, or a related field.
8+ years of experience developing battery algorithms or battery models in industry or research with a Master's degree, or 5+ years with a PhD.
Extensive experience launching battery products with leading automotive or grid storage OEMs may be considered in place of some of this experience.
Experience developing state of charge or state of health estimation algorithms for lithium-ion batteries, including building equivalent circuit models and using methods such as Kalman filtering or data-driven models.
Experience validating battery algorithms against laboratory and field data.
Expert proficiency in Python for building and validating battery models, and the ability to prototype algorithms in C.
Familiarity with automotive or battery energy storage system (BESS) safety standards, such as ISO 26262, UL 1973, or UL 9540A.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD in electrical engineering, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, applied mathematics, or a related field.
Experience building physics-based electrochemical models, such as the Doyle-Fuller-Newman (DFN) or single particle model (SPM) or other advanced battery models, and with lithium-ion aging mechanisms.
Experience with lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cells, including state of charge estimation across the flat voltage plateau and hysteresis.
Familiarity with lithium-ion failure modes and abuse hazards, such as overcharge, internal short, and thermal runaway, and experience developing algorithms to detect them.
Experience designing battery test protocols, such as hybrid pulse power characterization (HPPC), drive or duty cycles, and impedance spectroscopy.
Experience making technical trade-offs on a safety-critical product, where certification and field reliability constrain cost and schedule.
Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and effective across cultures, companies, and time zones.

added.title: Research Scientist, Viral and Molecular Tools
added.description:
About Astera

Astera is a private foundation on a mission to steer science and technology toward a better future. We believe the coming years will bring an era of unprecedented scientific and technological advancement as exponential progress in AI converges with central advances in other fields to accelerate innovation. This inflection point provides an unparalleled opportunity to fundamentally rethink the institutions, systems, and tools that drive progress. We have committed a $3.5B endowment to that work and fit the form of our support to the function it serves: grants, investments, and in-house research programs. We accept meaningful risk in the research we back and expect some of it to fail because transformative ideas are rarely the ones already proven. Our projects, and the foundation itself, operate like high-velocity startups, with a high performance bar and competitive compensation to match. We are searching for leaders who are compelled by the challenge of driving high-impact change in the way science is funded, conducted, and communicated. You can read more about our mission, vision, and programming at astera.org/vision.

Company Overview

Astera Neuro seeks to understand and engineer consciousness. We believe consciousness is the process by which the brain builds a coherent internal model of the world and the self. We aim to understand this model and to develop the technologies to write experience directly into the brain. By combining large-scale neural recording, causal perturbation, and brain-based AI, we seek to move neuroscience from observing correlates of experience to engineering it. The same tools carry direct therapeutic promise for neurological and psychiatric diseases that alter perception, thought, and sense of self. Because the science and tools required do not yet exist, we are assembling a founding team of neuroscientists, theorists, and engineers to create them. We do high-risk, high-reward science in a well-resourced, collaborative environment with competitive pay, and share everything openly under Astera’s Open Science Policy.

Position Summary

We are hiring a scientist to join Astera Neuro’s experimental neuroscience team and develop the viral and molecular tools the research program runs on. Your primary responsibility will be to develop and screen AAV-based tools for neural imaging and optogenetic manipulation, including new combinations of genetically encoded indicators and opsins, and new strategies for achieving efficient, specific, and reliable expression. These tools support all-optical experiments in mice and nonhuman primates (NHPs).

Reliable expression is a rate-limiting step for the experiments we intend to run, so the tools you build set the ceiling on what the rest of the program can attempt.

The ideal candidate pairs strong molecular biology with hands-on rodent or NHP surgery. You can design and generate a construct in the morning, perform stereotaxic injections in the afternoon, and quantify expression on the two-photon rig that evening. Animal wellbeing is foundational to this work, supported by dedicated veterinary and behavioral care staff and rigorous welfare standards.

We are hiring at multiple levels. As a Research Associate, you will run established molecular and screening workflows with regular guidance. As a Senior Research Associate, you will own the screening pipeline end to end and drive construct design decisions. As a Scientist, you will set the viral and transgenic expression strategy for the program, mentor research associates and technicians, and shape how tools work is planned with the experimental teams. We will calibrate scope and title to your experience.

What You’ll Do
Develop and screen AAV-based tools for neural imaging and optogenetic manipulation, including new indicator and opsin combinations and strategies for improving expression efficiency, specificity, and reliability.
Design, generate, and validate molecular constructs using cloning, plasmid preparation, sequence verification, and related molecular biology techniques.
Run the viral screening pipeline end to end in mice and NHPs, coordinating AAV production with external vendors and quantifying expression brightness, sparsity, titer dependence, volume dependence, and success rate.
Quantify expression in vivo using one-photon and two-photon imaging, including z-stacks, to establish whether co-expression resolves in single cells and whether a construct meets the requirements of downstream all-optical experiments.
Perform or support survival surgery in mice and NHPs: stereotaxic viral injection, chronic cranial-window implantation, and headbar installation.
Validate genetic tools in vitro and in vivo using fluorescence microscopy, tissue processing, and histology.
Support transgenic mouse breeding, genotyping, and genetic strategies for targeted expression.
Work closely with neuroscientists and engineers to integrate new genetic tools into imaging and optogenetic experiments.
Keep careful, shared records of constructs, viral preparations, screening results, surgeries, and protocols so others can build on the work.
Contribute to publications, talks, open data and tooling releases, and engagement with the broader scientific community.
Who You Are
Required
BS, MS, or PhD with 0 to 8+ years of experience in molecular biology, neuroscience, genetics, bioengineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. We value demonstrated skill and relevant experience above credentials.
Strong hands-on experience with molecular cloning, DNA construct design, and standard molecular biology techniques.
Experience with viral-vector-based gene delivery, particularly AAV systems.
Demonstrated hands-on experience performing stereotaxic viral injections in mice or NHPs.
Hands-on experience with tissue processing, histology, and fluorescence microscopy.
Ability to execute and troubleshoot molecular biology and animal experiments independently, while holding a high standard of experimental quality and reproducibility.
Strong organizational skills and careful record-keeping.
Preferred/Nice to Have
Chronic cranial-window implantation or related surgical preparations in NHPs.
Chronic cranial-window implantation in mice.
Developing or screening genetically encoded calcium or voltage indicators, optogenetic actuators, or related tools.
Developing high-throughput assays for screening viral constructs or genetic tools.
Transgenic mouse breeding, genotyping, and colony management.
Immunohistochemistry.
What We Value
Conviction that the brain’s internal model can be understood in full, and that getting there requires a kind of science no single academic lab can do; we are betting on scale, deep collaboration across science and engineering, and open sharing of ideas in a full-stack environment.
Willingness to be held to an engineering standard. In this role that standard lands on the tools: we treat expression reliability and screening yield as scientific results, not support work.

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

The candidate selected for the Senior Development Product Owner - AI Product Solutions
position will join AI enablement teams in USAA’s Technology organization.  The candidate will have an opportunity to support a value chain of AI delivery that runs from pilots through production.  The candidate selected for this position will be responsible for serving several AI domains and partnering with peers to manage dependencies and risks across the wider AI value chain. This includes working with multiple delivery teams and stakeholders through all stages of the development lifecycle. 

The candidate selected for this position will be accountable for attaining, understanding, and communicating business needs to manage backlogs of work including guiding teams of Data Scientists and AI Engineers in writing and refining features and stories, planning and prioritizing work, and managing risks to delivery plans. The candidate will also be responsible for ensuring development work adheres to applicable internal software development lifecycle controls. The candidate will demonstrate strong critical thinking, problem solving, and technical knowledge along with an expert ability to work across multiple delivery methodologies to plan and predictably deliver business value.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week.
This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX, Plano, TX, Phoenix, AZ, or Charlotte, NC. Relocation assistance is not
available for this position.

What You'll Do

Works with business and Subject Matter Experts to understand business strategy and vision and then writes, refines, accepts and prioritizes stories and/or features to support effective and compliant solutions while balancing investment and business value.
Owns and maintains a prioritized work backlog for one or more Agile teams. Product backlog includes complete user stories with acceptance criteria so that they are consumable and testable by the Agile team or program. Reviews and accepts output of I/T and/or business development to ensure specified acceptance criteria have been completed.
Serves as direct representative of the business with one or more delivery teams, representing the customers' perspective throughout the product delivery cycle.
Participates in a cross-functional team of user experience partners, designers, business analysts, developers, testers and others to develop, execute and release in alignment with program and/or product road maps.
Partners with sponsors, stakeholders, and IT to facilitate, define and document relevant business processes, gaining an advanced understanding of the needs, measures, and risks & controls for the improvement area.
Prepares the business for the change and provides tactics and metrics for benefits, adoption, and risk. Leverages existing change management routines, as needed.
Works with different technologies, internal and external to have oversight of development, testing and controls.
Applies advanced knowledge in the business development/execution discipline, regularly seeking out opportunities to enhance, improve and advance the function.
Coaches and mentors other Product Owners.
Demonstrates advanced knowledge in multiple business or system domains and capable of leading development across multiple teams at the project or program level.
Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
6 years of experience in process improvement, project delivery, business/requirements analysis or directly related to supported business operations/product line.
Advanced knowledge of the AI development lifecycle including data science run pilots and engineering run productionalization and hardening.
Advanced experience analyzing business requirements, process flows and use cases to identify opportunities to streamline business processes in accordance with risk management framework and regulatory requirements.
Advanced knowledge and demonstrated use of Process Engineering methodologies.
Proven ability to independently work to gather business requirements, process flows and use cases to develop and deliver on business capabilities within the approved methodology, writing user stories, and following the development process through user story acceptance.
Experience analyzing business requirements and proven ability to identify opportunities to drive decisions and streamline business processes in accordance with risk management framework and regulatory requirements.

What Sets You Apart

5 or more years of experience delivering successful AI / Machine Learning (ML) products.
3 or more years of experience in enterprise technology, Data Science, or AI/ML product/program management at a major financial institution.
3 or more years of experience managing delivery team backlog and workflow in systems of record such as JIRA and Clarity.
3 or more years of experience managing execution and delivery of code development, from story writing to production, in a timely and predictable manner.
3 or more years of experience successfully managing development team and/or program-level risks and dependencies across large technology organizations. Including identifying and assessing risks and dependencies, managing and/or mitigating risks and dependencies, documenting risk and dependency statuses, and presenting risk and dependency statuses to leaders and stakeholders.
Technical understanding: comfortable asking questions and understanding AI concepts and their derivative business value including managing data requirements and discussing technical trade-offs and challenges with data scientist and AI engineers.
Proven ability to decompose features into iterative stories, prioritize stories in a backlog, align the backlog to a sprint cadence, and release planned story work for incremental delivery.
Proven success managing release processes including assessing and documenting testing, determining whether code meets product requirements, demonstrating technology concepts and working technology, post release validation, and accountability for documenting work completion.
Experience working with, engaging, and influencing multiple cross-functional teams and leaders including data scientists, engineers, and other personnel across geographically distributed work environments to deliver working technology.
Proven bias towards informed action demonstrated by taking initiative to develop an understanding of ambiguous development challenges and/or stakeholder business needs, planning a path forward, and generating buy-in for quick impactful action.
US military experience through military service or a military spouse/domestic partner

Compensation range:
The salary range for this position is: $103,450 - $197,730.

USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Compensation:
USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.
